purpose: User-requested duplicate and sharper full kill-chain alternative
prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: high resolution 16:9 keynote technical diagram for a public software supply chain security conference. Rebuild the reference Shai-Hulud 2.0 full kill chain into a MUCH sharper, simpler, polished architectural infographic. Aim 3840x2160. Dark ink near-black background, thin crisp cream/cyan connectors, restrained amber and violet highlights, destructive branch coral red. Large perfectly typeset text, strong spacing, no glows, no hoodie, no skull, no tiny duplicate legend. Diagram fills image with 7% safe margins; no title (will be native slide text). Essential left to right story across middle: box 1 'INSTALL' subtitle 'Poisoned npm package' -> box 2 'EXECUTE' subtitle 'preinstall · Bun payload' -> box 3 'DISCOVER' subtitle 'TruffleHog · local / CI / cloud secrets'. Then right half splits into three clearly separate outcomes with generous space: upper 'PROPAGATE' subtitle 'npm token → poisoned releases' with obvious large return arrow looping back to INSTALL across TOP; middle 'EXFILTRATE' subtitle 'GitHub token → public repositories'; lower 'PERSIST' subtitle 'Workflow / self-hosted runner'. A GitHub token branch from DISCOVER must feed BOTH EXFILTRATE and PERSIST, and the npm token only PROPAGATE. Add a separate thin coral branch below discovery with explicit condition 'No GitHub token AND no valid npm token' -> small red box 'DESTRUCTIVE FALLBACK' subtitle 'Wipe home directory · exit'. Other secrets small non-dominant label at discovery 'Cloud / API credentials'. Show install can occur on 'Developer machine or CI runner' as small shared context below INSTALL and EXECUTE. Six stages numbered 01 execute, 02 discover, 03 propagate, 04 exfiltrate, 05 persist, 06 destructive fallback (install is input not separate numbered stage). Preserve exact AND condition, no unconditional wipe, no arrow from persistence to wipe. One clean line icon each stage; large labels no extra repeated text, no attack totals, no graphs. Diagram must visually convey the publish feedback loop and identity branches; not a row of disconnected cards. Reference provides factual structure only; redesign completely for conference back-row readability.
notes: Original preserved. Larger six-stage labels, no duplicate legend, explicit npm return loop, shared GitHub branches, separate AND-conditioned destructive fallback. Tool returned 1672×941; not claimed as 4K.
